title: Freeze stable and development Lean lane candidates
goal: Qualify exact current stable and RC/dependency candidates without changing the governed corpus.
acceptance_criteria: Official release identities and artifact hashes are recorded; each execution pin is immutable.
Effective compiler after dependency resolution equals the selected lane; caches are isolated by complete closure.
If no newer RC exists, stable development fallback is explicit; failed checker/dependency compatibility remains an infrastructure blocker.
human_review: Toolchain/dependency admission review; no automatic downgrade
scope_rule: Only explicitly sealed artifact/file scope; meaning, checker, workflow, release and reporting changes require dedicated independent human review.
null_binding_reason: Candidate project source exists, but this template's task-specific reviewed target, dependency and acceptance identities are not sealed; the applicable manual-review policy or qualified validator must be frozen before any live claim.
